zh: 登录页不再显示各部门密码，密码只在后台查看和修改
网站端与后台合并为一个网址；总经理可以授权其他账号使用后台
非洲 54 国语言与当地货币、美元实时汇率；各部门各司其职；财务；门店与 VIP；修复闪动；Excel 报表带边框
en: Department passwords no longer shown on the sign-in page; manage them in the backend only
Website and backend merged into one address; the general manager can grant backend access to other accounts
54-country languages and local currency with live USD rates; departments in their own lanes; finance; stores & VIP; flicker fixed; bordered Excel reports
